sentences.text:
Learned counsel for applicant submitted that although proceeding of Special Sessions Trial no. 30 of 2014 has been put under challenge through the instant application, but at the same time, learned AGA sought the attention of the Court that the charges have already been framed way back in the year 2014 itself.
4. It is admitted case of the learned counsel for the applicant that the stage of the trial has already been passed over under recording statement under Section 313 of Cr.P.C. Attraction of Section 4 of the POCSO Act has been especially mentioned by learned counsel for the applicant and submitted that the same has not been attracted but even through the charges have been framed without having corresponding section of IPC i.e. Section 376 and as such the matter cannot be tried in pursuance to framing of charges especially under Section 4 of POCSO Act.
5.

The grounds mentioned through the instant application is subject to adjudication of learned trial court and the trial cannot be disturbed at this highly belated stage wherein the process of receiving statement for defence under Section 313 Cr.P.C. has already been gone.
6. Prayer made in the instant application cannot be acceded hence instant application u/s 528 BNSS stands disposed of.
